truong-vocab-set-25: Truong vocabulary practice words from set 25.

column3: An explanation for why something happened or why you think or do something
column7: My reason for wearing boots is that it is raining.

column3: What happens because of an action, event, or process
column7: The result of watering the seed was a new sprout.

column3: Something that makes another thing happen
column7: The cause of the noise was a barking dog.

column3: Something that happens because of a cause
column7: One effect of the rain was a puddle on the sidewalk.

column3: Alike in some ways but not exactly the same
column7: The two shells are similar because both are round and striped.
The two buttons are different colors.

column3: Something that repeats or follows a rule
column7: The beads make a red, blue, red, blue pattern.

column3: Something done, understood, or answered incorrectly
column7: I made a mistake, fixed it, and tried the problem again.
A careless spill can make the floor slippery.

column3: A plan or method for reaching a goal or solving a problem
column7: My strategy is to count by tens first.
